purpose: Prevent duplicate analytical rows caused by browser/network retries without introducing identity tracking.

client.generation: cryptographically random UUIDv4 generated for one form-submission attempt
client.retry_rule: reuse the same key for retries of the same attempted submission; generate a new key only for a deliberate new submission
client.persistence: memory or same-tab session state only; no cookie and no cross-site persistence

server.stored_key_material: store only the derived response_id; do not store the raw idempotency key in the analytical record or export
server.body_digest: sha256 of canonical normalized analytical submission body excluding transport metadata
server.same_key_same_body: return the original success receipt and do not append another row
server.same_key_different_body: HTTP 409 semantic / fail closed before any second write
server.new_key: validate normally and append at most one row if all privacy and schema gates pass

privacy_constraints: MUST NOT derive the key from name, email, phone, CNP, employer identity, IP address or user-agent
MUST NOT use browser fingerprinting, advertising identifiers, CRM IDs or analytics IDs
MUST NOT export the raw key or body digest to NF06 or any analysis dataset
MUST NOT weaken the PROD synthetic=false gate
required_tests: same key + same normalized body => one stored row and replay-safe success
same key + different normalized body => conflict / no write
two different keys + identical answer bodies => two legitimate rows
missing or malformed key => fail closed once production endpoint is enabled
synthetic=true cannot enter the PROD idempotent storage path
idempotency metadata is absent from immutable NF06 analytical export
